name: Kotake (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kotake town emblem in green: an outlined ring of segments with stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Kotake, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1938.

features.role: Kotake town emblem — an outlined ring of segments with stylised characters
